title: Precise Expression Words
sub: Sharper verbs and adjectives to replace vague, everyday ones.

cards.def:
To become less intense or widespread
हिंदी: कम होना / शांत पड़ना
examples: The alerts abated once the backlog cleared.
The storm abated by evening, and the flights resumed.
Her fear abated once she met the interview panel.
The pain abated after I took the medicine.

cards.def:
To make more noticeable
हिंदी: उभारना
examples: The data accentuates the gap between teams.
The bright lights accentuate the colours of the painting.
Her dark glasses accentuated the sharp features of her face.
The crisis accentuated the need for savings.

cards.def:
To gradually gather or build up
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे जमा होना
examples: Technical debt accumulates quickly under pressure.
Dust accumulates quickly on the window sill.
Unread emails accumulate when I'm on leave.
She accumulated years of experience in sales.

cards.def:
Very skilled at something
हिंदी: निपुण
examples: She is adept at simplifying complex topics.
He is adept at handling angry customers.
My grandmother is adept at making perfect rotis.
Children quickly become adept at using smartphones.

cards.def:
To stick firmly to a rule or plan
हिंदी: पालन करना
examples: Teams must adhere to the release checklist.
Please adhere to the dress code at the client office.
Staff must adhere to safety rules in the factory.
It's hard to adhere to a diet during festivals.

cards.def:
The arrival of a notable thing
हिंदी: आगमन
examples: The advent of cloud computing changed infrastructure forever.
The advent of smartphones changed how we shop.
With the advent of UPI, cash use dropped.
The advent of the monsoon brings relief from the heat.

cards.def:
To state something firmly as true
हिंदी: दृढ़ता से कहना
examples: The review affirmed our design choices.
The court affirmed the lower court's decision.
She affirmed her commitment to the project.
The survey affirmed that customers like the new design.

cards.def:
To make a problem worse or more serious
हिंदी: और बिगाड़ना
examples: Delays aggravated the client's frustration.
Lifting heavy bags aggravated his back injury.
Rude replies only aggravate the situation.
Pollution aggravates asthma in children.

cards.def:
Having mixed feelings about something
हिंदी: दुविधा में / मिश्रित भावनाओं वाला
examples: He felt ambivalent about moving to management.
I'm ambivalent about moving to Bengaluru.
Voters seem ambivalent about both candidates.
She felt ambivalent about leaving her first job.

cards.def:
Open and willing to accept suggestions
हिंदी: सुझाव मानने को तैयार
examples: The vendor was amenable to changing the format.
The landlord was amenable to lowering the rent.
Is your manager amenable to flexible hours?
The client was amenable to a short delay.

cards.def:
To increase the strength or effect of something
हिंदी: प्रभाव बढ़ाना
examples: Social media amplifies small controversies.
The microphone amplifies the speaker's voice.
Stress can amplify small problems.
The news channel amplified the rumour.

cards.def:
Based on personal accounts rather than facts
हिंदी: व्यक्तिगत अनुभव पर आधारित
examples: The evidence is anecdotal and needs verification.
Most of what we know about the problem is anecdotal.
Anecdotal stories suggest the app is popular with students.
Don't make policy based on anecdotal evidence.

cards.def:
Strong hostility or ill feeling
हिंदी: शत्रुता
examples: Past disputes created animosity between the teams.
There was no animosity between the two candidates after the debate.
Old animosity between the brothers ruined the family event.
The manager tried to reduce animosity in the team.

cards.def:
Lack of interest or concern
हिंदी: उदासीनता
examples: Voter apathy weakens democracy.
Public apathy allowed the problem to grow.
Student apathy towards the subject worried the teacher.
Employee apathy is a sign of poor leadership.

cards.def:
To calm someone by giving in to demands
हिंदी: शांत करने के लिए मान लेना
examples: We can't appease every stakeholder.
The company offered a discount to appease angry customers.
He gave the children sweets to appease them.
Don't change the plan just to appease one person.

cards.def:
Based on random choice rather than reason
हिंदी: मनमाना
examples: The deadline seems arbitrary and unrealistic.
The selection seemed arbitrary to the candidates.
Arbitrary rules frustrate employees.
He picked an arbitrary number for the test.

cards.def:
Showing strong enthusiasm
हिंदी: उत्साही
examples: She is an ardent supporter of open source.
My uncle is an ardent cricket fan.
She is an ardent believer in women's education.
The ardent volunteers worked all night.

cards.def:
Involving great effort and difficulty
हिंदी: कठिन परिश्रम वाला
examples: The migration was an arduous process.
The climb to the temple was long and arduous.
Getting a visa can be an arduous process.
After an arduous week, I slept all Sunday.

cards.def:
To express a future goal clearly
हिंदी: दृष्टि स्पष्ट रूप से रखना
examples: Good leaders articulate a vision people can follow.
The new principal articulated a vision for the school.
Founders must articulate a vision to attract investors.
She articulated a vision of a paperless office.

cards.def:
To find out for certain
हिंदी: निश्चित रूप से पता लगाना
examples: We must ascertain the facts before reporting.
The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
Please ascertain whether the client has paid.
It's hard to ascertain the truth from rumours.

cards.def:
To have a strong desire to achieve something
हिंदी: आकांक्षा रखना
examples: She aspires to become a principal engineer.
Many young people aspire to work abroad.
He aspires to start his own restaurant.
Students aspire to get into the top colleges.

cards.def:
Showing great care and persistence
हिंदी: परिश्रमी
examples: Assiduous testing caught the rare bug.
She was assiduous in preparing for the exam.
His assiduous work earned him a promotion.
The editor made assiduous checks on every fact.

cards.def:
Clever at judging situations to gain advantage
हिंदी: कुशाग्र बुद्धि वाला
examples: Her astute observation saved us from a costly mistake.
The astute buyer waited for the sale.
An astute investor noticed the trend early.
She made an astute comment about the market.

cards.def:
To regard something as being caused by
हिंदी: श्रेय/कारण मानना
examples: We attribute the delay to vendor issues.
He attributes his success to his parents' support.
Doctors attribute the illness to dirty water.
The quote is often attributed to Gandhi.

cards.def:
To make greater by adding to it
हिंदी: बढ़ाना / पूरक बनाना
examples: We augmented the data with sector information.
She augments her income by teaching online.
We augmented the team with two contractors.
The new data augments our earlier findings.

cards.def:
Showing signs of future success
हिंदी: शुभ / अनुकूल
examples: The pilot was an auspicious start.
The wedding was held on an auspicious day.
The new office opened at an auspicious time.
Winning the first match was an auspicious start to the season.

cards.def:
Severe and plain, without luxury
हिंदी: कठोर और सादा
examples: An austere budget limited our hiring.
The monk lived an austere life.
The hostel room was small and austere.
The government introduced austere measures to cut debt.

cards.def:
Having a keen interest or enthusiasm
हिंदी: उत्साही
examples: He is an avid reader of technical blogs.
My father is an avid gardener.
She's an avid traveller who has visited twenty countries.
Avid fans queued overnight for tickets.

cards.def:
Lacking originality and boring
हिंदी: नीरस और साधारण
examples: The presentation was banal and uninspiring.
The film had a banal plot and poor acting.
Avoid banal phrases like think outside the box in essays.
Their conversation was banal, mostly about the weather.

cards.def:
To strengthen or support
हिंदी: मज़बूत करना
examples: Extra monitoring bolstered confidence in the system.
The win bolstered the team's confidence.
The bank bolstered its security after the fraud.
Good reviews bolstered sales of the book.

cards.def:
Shortness of expression
हिंदी: संक्षिप्तता
examples: Brevity is the soul of a good status update.
Brevity is important in emails to busy managers.
The speech was praised for its brevity.
For the sake of brevity, I'll skip the details.

cards.def:
Involving excessive rules and procedures
हिंदी: नौकरशाही वाला
examples: The bureaucratic process delayed approvals.
Getting a simple certificate was a bureaucratic nightmare.
The bureaucratic company took months to approve anything.
We want to reduce bureaucratic steps for customers.

cards.def:
To give support or strength to
हिंदी: सहारा देना
examples: Data buttressed her argument.
Wooden beams buttress the old wall.
Strong sales buttressed the company's share price.
He buttressed his case with customer quotes.

cards.def:
Honest and direct comments
हिंदी: स्पष्ट प्रतिक्रिया
examples: Candid feedback helps us improve faster.
I asked my mentor for candid feedback on my resume.
Candid feedback can hurt but helps you grow.
The survey gives employees a way to share candid feedback.

cards.def:
To take advantage of an opportunity
हिंदी: अवसर का लाभ उठाना
examples: We can capitalise on the momentum from the pilot.
The shop capitalised on the festival season with special offers.
Capitalise on your language skills in the job market.
The team failed to capitalise on its early lead.

cards.def:
Capturing attention and interest
हिंदी: मनमोहक
examples: She gave a captivating talk on resilience.
The children found the puppet show captivating.
The book has a captivating opening chapter.
Her captivating smile made everyone feel welcome.

cards.def:
To express strong disapproval
हिंदी: कड़ी निंदा करना
examples: The committee censured the careless handling of data.
The council censured the officer for misconduct.
The board censured the CEO for misleading investors.
The doctor was censured by the medical council.

cards.def:
A long-standing recurring problem
हिंदी: पुरानी बार-बार आने वाली समस्या
examples: Late vendor files are a chronic issue.
Water shortage is a chronic issue in our town.
Late payments are a chronic issue with this client.
Back pain became a chronic issue after years at a desk.

cards.def:
Careful to consider all consequences before acting
हिंदी: सोच-समझकर चलने वाला
examples: Be circumspect when changing production configurations.
Be circumspect about sharing personal details online.
The minister was circumspect in his reply.
A circumspect investor checks everything before buying.

cards.def:
Kept secret, often illicit
हिंदी: गुप्त
examples: A clandestine integration bypassed our controls.
The police raided a clandestine factory making fake medicines.
They held clandestine meetings before announcing the merger.
The spy sent clandestine messages to his handlers.

cards.def:
The quality of being clear
हिंदी: स्पष्टता
examples: Clarity of ownership prevents confusion.
The new glasses gave me perfect clarity.
We need clarity on the budget before planning.
Her speech had great clarity and purpose.

cards.def:
Having knowledge or awareness
हिंदी: जानकार / अवगत
examples: We are cognisant of the risks involved.
She is cognisant of her own weaknesses.
Be cognisant of cultural differences when travelling.
Managers must be cognisant of employee wellbeing.

cards.def:
To praise formally
हिंदी: सराहना करना
examples: The manager commended her handling of the incident.
The principal commended the students for their honesty.
I commend you for your patience with the customer.
The report commended the hospital for its quick response.

cards.def:
Corresponding in size or degree
हिंदी: अनुपात के अनुरूप
examples: Salary should be commensurate with experience.
The reward was commensurate with the effort.
Responsibilities should be commensurate with the title.
We offer a salary commensurate with the market.

cards.def:
Able to exist or work together
हिंदी: संगत
examples: The library is not compatible with our Java version.
Is this charger compatible with my phone?
Their personalities are not compatible.
Make sure the software is compatible with Windows.

cards.def:
Self-satisfied and unaware of danger
हिंदी: आत्मसंतुष्ट
examples: Don't become complacent after one successful release.
The team became complacent after winning three matches.
Don't get complacent about your health.
A complacent company can lose to new competitors.

cards.def:
To add features that improve or enhance
हिंदी: पूरक बनना
examples: Good tooling complements strong processes.
The chutney complements the samosas perfectly.
Her skills complement mine.
A good scarf complements a simple outfit.

cards.def:
To act in accordance with a rule
हिंदी: नियम का पालन करना
examples: All teams must comply with the security policy.
All restaurants must comply with hygiene rules.
If you don't comply, you'll pay a fine.
The company complied with the court's order.

cards.def:
To agree
हिंदी: सहमत होना
examples: I concur with the proposed approach.
The doctors concurred that surgery was necessary.
I concur; the plan needs more time.
Most experts concur with the report's findings.

cards.def:
To accept or allow behaviour that is wrong
हिंदी: अनुचित को चलने देना
examples: We cannot condone skipping code reviews.
The school does not condone bullying.
I don't condone cheating, even in small games.
By staying silent, you seem to condone the behaviour.

cards.def:
To discuss something together
हिंदी: आपस में विचार-विमर्श करना
examples: Let me confer with the team before committing.
The doctors conferred before telling the family.
The judges conferred and announced the winner.
I need to confer with my partner before deciding.

cards.def:
An opinion based on incomplete information
हिंदी: अनुमान
examples: That's just conjecture until we see the logs.
The reason for his resignation is still a matter of conjecture.
Her theory is pure conjecture.
The media is full of conjecture about the actor's wedding.

cards.def:
To strengthen advantages already achieved
हिंदी: प्राप्त लाभों को मज़बूत करना
examples: Let's consolidate our gains before expanding scope.
After the big win, the party worked to consolidate gains.
Consolidate gains in English by practising daily.
The army moved to consolidate gains before advancing.

cards.def:
Easily seen and noticeable
हिंदी: स्पष्ट दिखने वाला
examples: His absence from the meeting was conspicuous.
She wore a conspicuous red hat at the wedding.
The new building is conspicuous on the skyline.
Don't make yourself conspicuous by arriving late.

cards.def:
To think deeply about something
हिंदी: गहराई से विचार करना
examples: We contemplated rewriting the module from scratch.
She is contemplating a career change.
He sat by the river, contemplating his future.
We contemplated moving abroad but decided to stay.

cards.def:
To argue or claim
हिंदी: दावा करना / तर्क देना
examples: He contends that the architecture is sound.
Critics contend that the policy hurts small businesses.
The lawyer contends that her client is innocent.
Some contend that exams don't measure real learning.

cards.def:
Dependent on something else happening
हिंदी: किसी बात पर निर्भर
examples: Approval is contingent on a successful security scan.
The offer is contingent on a background check.
Our trip is contingent on getting leave.
The deal is contingent on board approval.

cards.def:
To create or manage cleverly or artificially
हिंदी: तरकीब से बनाना
examples: The example felt contrived and unrealistic.
She contrived a way to leave the meeting early.
The film's ending felt contrived.
He contrived to meet her at the station by chance.

cards.def:
Abundant in quantity
हिंदी: प्रचुर
examples: She took copious notes during the review.
Drink copious amounts of water in summer.
The guests ate copious amounts of biryani.
The report includes copious examples.

cards.def:
Supporting information that confirms a claim
हिंदी: पुष्टि करने वाले प्रमाण
examples: We need corroborating evidence from the logs.
The CCTV footage provided corroborating evidence.
Without corroborating evidence, the complaint was dismissed.
The journalist looked for corroborating evidence before publishing.

cards.def:
To reach a final point or climax
हिंदी: चरम पर पहुँचना
examples: Months of work culminated in a smooth launch.
The festival culminated in a grand fireworks show.
Her years of study culminated in a medical degree.
The talks culminated in a peace deal.

cards.def:
To reduce expenditure
हिंदी: ख़र्च में कटौती करना
examples: The team had to curtail spending on tools.
Families curtail spending when prices rise.
The government plans to curtail spending on new buildings.
We had to curtail spending after losing the client.

cards.def:
Hasty and not thorough
हिंदी: सरसरी
examples: A cursory review missed the critical bug.
He gave the contract only a cursory glance before signing.
A cursory check of the room showed nothing missing.
The doctor's cursory examination worried the patient.

cards.def:
Seeming difficult and intimidating
हिंदी: डरा देने वाला
examples: The scale of the migration was daunting.
Moving to a new country alone can be daunting.
The first day at a new job is always a little daunting.
Facing a daunting pile of work, she made a list.

cards.def:
Making someone or something weak
हिंदी: कमज़ोर करने वाला
examples: Constant interruptions are debilitating for productivity.
Migraines can be debilitating.
The long illness left him debilitated for months.
High debt can have a debilitating effect on small businesses.

cards.def:
To succeed in understanding something unclear
हिंदी: गूढ़ बात समझना
examples: It took hours to decipher the legacy code.
I couldn't decipher the doctor's handwriting.
Archaeologists deciphered the ancient script.
It's hard to decipher what my manager really wants.

cards.def:
To consider or judge in a particular way
हिंदी: मानना / समझना
examples: The change was deemed too risky for Friday.
The building was deemed unsafe after the earthquake.
Use whatever method you deem best.
The film was deemed unsuitable for children.

cards.def:
To yield to another's opinion or authority
हिंदी: किसी की राय को मान देना
examples: I'll defer to the security team on this.
On legal matters, I defer to our lawyer.
Junior staff often defer to seniors in meetings.
I'll defer to your judgement on the venue.

cards.def:
Not having enough of something
हिंदी: अपर्याप्त
examples: The documentation is deficient in key areas.
Her diet was deficient in iron.
The report found the safety training deficient.
Many children are deficient in vitamin D.

cards.def:
To describe or outline precisely
हिंदी: सटीक रूप से रेखांकित करना
examples: The charter delineates each team's responsibilities.
The contract delineates the duties of both parties.
The map delineates the borders of each district.
Her essay clearly delineates the causes of the problem.

cards.def:
To be a sign of; to indicate
हिंदी: दर्शाना
examples: A red flag denotes a failed check.
The star symbol denotes a vegetarian dish.
A green light denotes that the machine is ready.
In maths, x often denotes an unknown number.

cards.def:
To represent or show in a picture or words
हिंदी: चित्रित करना
examples: The diagram depicts the end-to-end flow.
The painting depicts village life in Bengal.
The film depicts the struggles of a young cricketer.
The report depicts a worrying picture of air quality.

cards.def:
To obtain from a source
हिंदी: प्राप्त करना
examples: We derive insights from usage data.
Many English words derive from Latin.
She derives great joy from teaching.
The company derives most of its income from exports.

cards.def:
Objective and not emotionally involved
हिंदी: निर्लिप्त / तटस्थ
examples: Review the incident with a detached mind.
A judge must stay detached from personal feelings.
He seemed detached during the family dinner.
Try to give feedback in a detached, professional way.

cards.def:
To plan or invent something complex
हिंदी: योजना या तरीका गढ़ना
examples: We devised a strategy to avoid duplicate loads.
The teacher devised a fun game to teach grammar.
They devised a plan to save water in the building.
Engineers devised a cheaper way to build the bridge.

cards.def:
To make or become smaller
हिंदी: घटाना / कम होना
examples: Repeated failures diminished confidence.
The noise diminished as the train moved away.
His interest in the job diminished over time.
Don't let one failure diminish your confidence.

cards.def:
To recognise or notice something with effort
हिंदी: पहचान पाना
examples: It's hard to discern a pattern in the noise.
I could barely discern the road in the fog.
It's hard to discern his true feelings.
A good editor can discern weak arguments quickly.

cards.def:
Careful about what one says to avoid embarrassment
हिंदी: विवेकपूर्ण / गोपनीयता बरतने वाला
examples: Please be discreet about the restructuring plans.
She was discreet about her colleague's health problems.
Please be discreet; the news isn't public yet.
He made a discreet exit before the speeches.

cards.def:
A great difference
हिंदी: भारी अंतर
examples: There's a disparity between the two teams' workloads.
There is a big disparity between rich and poor in the city.
The pay disparity between men and women must end.
The disparity in test scores surprised the teachers.

cards.def:
To make a doubt or belief disappear
हिंदी: भ्रम दूर करना
examples: The test results dispelled our concerns.
The manager's email dispelled rumours of layoffs.
Education helps dispel myths about illness.
Her calm voice dispelled the children's fear.

cards.def:
To spread information widely
हिंदी: जानकारी फैलाना
examples: We disseminate release notes to all stakeholders.
The health ministry disseminated advice about the virus.
Social media disseminates news very quickly.
We need to disseminate the new policy to all branches.

cards.def:
To extract the essential meaning
हिंदी: सार निकालना
examples: Distil the findings into three key points.
The book distils years of experience into simple lessons.
Can you distil the report into one slide?
She distilled the long discussion into three decisions.

cards.def:
To depart from a path or opinion
हिंदी: रास्ते या मत से हटना
examples: The final design diverged from the original plan.
The film diverged from the novel in many ways.
His career diverged from his father's plans.
Don't diverge from the agreed budget without approval.

cards.def:
Temporarily inactive
हिंदी: निष्क्रिय
examples: A dormant account was exploited by attackers.
The volcano has been dormant for centuries.
My interest in painting lay dormant for years.
Seeds remain dormant until the rains come.

cards.def:
Not to be relied upon; doubtful
हिंदी: संदिग्ध
examples: The numbers come from a dubious source.
I'm dubious about his promise to repay the loan.
The website looked dubious, so I didn't buy anything.
He has a dubious record of keeping deadlines.

cards.def:
To draw out a response or information
हिंदी: जानकारी या प्रतिक्रिया निकलवाना
examples: The workshop elicited several unspoken concerns.
The teacher's questions elicited thoughtful answers.
The survey elicited over a thousand responses.
His joke elicited laughter from the audience.

cards.def:
Difficult to find, catch or achieve
हिंदी: पकड़ में न आने वाला
examples: The elusive bug appeared only at midnight.
Success remained elusive for the young actor.
The elusive leopard was finally caught on camera.
A good night's sleep has been elusive this week.

cards.def:
To come out from a source
हिंदी: उत्पन्न होना / निकलना
examples: The pressure emanated from senior management.
A lovely smell emanated from the kitchen.
Warmth emanated from the fireplace.
Confidence seemed to emanate from her.

cards.def:
To begin a new project or journey
हिंदी: नई शुरुआत करना
examples: We embarked on a major modernisation effort.
She embarked on a new career in teaching.
We embarked on a road trip across Rajasthan.
The company is embarking on a big expansion.

cards.def:
To fix firmly within something larger
हिंदी: गहराई से जोड़ना
examples: Security should be embedded in the design process.
The video was embedded in the webpage.
Respect for elders is embedded in our culture.
A small stone was embedded in the tyre.

cards.def:
To represent or express in a concrete form
हिंदी: साकार रूप देना
examples: The platform embodies our principles of reliability.
She embodies the spirit of hard work.
The new building embodies modern design.
He embodies everything a good teacher should be.

cards.def:
Based on observation or experiment
हिंदी: अनुभवजन्य
examples: We need empirical data before deciding.
The claim has no empirical support.
Empirical studies show that exercise improves mood.
Scientists gathered empirical evidence over ten years.

cards.def:
To include comprehensively
हिंदी: समेटना
examples: The review encompasses security and performance.
The course encompasses grammar, speaking and writing.
The national park encompasses three districts.
Her role encompasses both sales and marketing.

cards.def:
An earnest attempt
हिंदी: प्रयास
examples: The migration was a major endeavour.
Climbing the mountain was a dangerous endeavour.
We wish you success in your future endeavours.
Starting a school was her lifelong endeavour.

cards.def:
Difficult to interpret or understand
हिंदी: रहस्यमय
examples: The enigmatic error message offered no clues.
The painting has an enigmatic smile.
He gave an enigmatic reply and left.
The enigmatic stranger never told us his name.

cards.def:
To happen afterwards as a result
हिंदी: परिणामस्वरूप घटित होना
examples: A heated debate ensued after the proposal.
After the announcement, chaos ensued in the office.
A long silence ensued after his question.
If you don't pay, legal action will ensue.

cards.def:
To involve as a necessary part
हिंदी: आवश्यक रूप से शामिल करना
examples: The change entails updating every consumer.
What does the new role entail?
Buying a house entails a lot of paperwork.
Moving abroad entails learning a new culture.

cards.def:
To imagine as a future possibility
हिंदी: कल्पना करना
examples: We envisage a fully automated pipeline.
I envisage working from home two days a week.
The planners envisage a metro line to the airport.
She never envisaged becoming a manager so soon.

cards.def:
Fair and impartial
हिंदी: न्यायसंगत
examples: We need an equitable distribution of on-call duties.
The property was divided in an equitable way among the children.
We want an equitable pay structure for all staff.
Equitable access to education is a basic right.

cards.def:
Wrong or mistaken
हिंदी: त्रुटिपूर्ण
examples: An erroneous assumption caused the failure.
The newspaper corrected its erroneous report.
An erroneous entry delayed my tax refund.
The bank apologised for the erroneous charge.

cards.def:
To adopt or support a cause or belief
हिंदी: किसी विचार को अपनाना और समर्थन करना
examples: She espouses test-driven development.
The party espouses free education for all.
He espouses a simple, minimalist lifestyle.
Many leaders espouse values they don't follow.

cards.def:
To bring a feeling or memory to mind
हिंदी: स्मृति या भावना जगाना
examples: The error evoked memories of last year's outage.
The smell of rain evokes memories of my childhood.
The old song evoked strong feelings in the audience.
The photograph evokes a sense of peace.

cards.def:
To be a typical example of
हिंदी: उदाहरण पेश करना
examples: This incident exemplifies the need for better alerts.
Her life exemplifies courage and kindness.
This project exemplifies good teamwork.
These buildings exemplify colonial architecture.

cards.def:
Thorough and complete
हिंदी: संपूर्ण
examples: We ran an exhaustive set of regression tests.
The police made an exhaustive search of the area.
This is not an exhaustive list of rules.
The doctor ran exhaustive tests to find the cause.

cards.def:
To clear of blame
हिंदी: दोष-मुक्त करना
examples: The logs exonerated the deployment team.
New evidence exonerated the accused man.
The report exonerated the driver of any blame.
He was exonerated after years in prison.

cards.def:
Convenient and practical, though not always ethical
हिंदी: तात्कालिक रूप से सुविधाजनक
examples: Skipping the review was expedient but risky.
It was expedient to hire a temporary worker.
The politician took the expedient route and avoided the issue.
Lying may seem expedient, but it causes trouble later.

cards.def:
Clear and direct permission
हिंदी: स्पष्ट सहमति
examples: We need explicit consent before sharing data.
Apps must get explicit consent before using your location.
The hospital needs explicit consent before surgery.
Never share a photo of someone without explicit consent.

cards.def:
Serving as a desirable model
हिंदी: आदर्श
examples: Her exemplary documentation became our template.
The student received an award for exemplary behaviour.
His exemplary service was recognised by the company.
The school's results were exemplary this year.

cards.def:
Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject
हिंदी: अप्रासंगिक
examples: Remove extraneous details from the summary.
The essay was full of extraneous information.
Remove extraneous noise from the recording.
Keep your resume short and cut extraneous details.

cards.def:
One aspect of something
हिंदी: पहलू
examples: Every facet of the system was reviewed.
We discussed every facet of the wedding plan.
Music is one facet of her many talents.
The course covers each facet of digital marketing.

cards.def:
Very attentive to accuracy and detail
हिंदी: अति सावधान और बारीक
examples: He is fastidious about naming conventions.
My mother is fastidious about keeping the kitchen clean.
The fastidious editor checked every comma.
He's fastidious about his clothes and always looks neat.

cards.def:
A practical answer that can be implemented
हिंदी: व्यवहार्य समाधान
examples: We found a feasible solution within budget.
We need a feasible solution, not a perfect one.
Working from home was the only feasible solution during the floods.
The engineers came up with a feasible solution in a week.

cards.def:
Having intense feeling
हिंदी: उत्कट
examples: He is a fervent supporter of automation.
She made a fervent appeal for donations.
He is a fervent fan of the local football club.
The crowd gave fervent support to the team.

cards.def:
Obviously and shockingly wrong
हिंदी: खुला उल्लंघन वाला
examples: It was a flagrant breach of the policy.
The referee ignored a flagrant foul.
It was a flagrant violation of traffic rules.
The company showed flagrant disregard for worker safety.

cards.def:
Growing and developing well
हिंदी: फलता-फूलता
examples: A flourishing community supports the open-source tool.
The flourishing garden is full of flowers.
Her flourishing business now has three branches.
The city has a flourishing art scene.

cards.def:
Changing frequently and irregularly
हिंदी: घटता-बढ़ता
examples: Fluctuating demand complicates planning.
Fluctuating fuel prices affect bus fares.
The patient's fluctuating temperature worried the nurse.
Fluctuating exchange rates make imports risky.

cards.def:
Inspiring fear or respect through size or power
हिंदी: भयावह / प्रभावशाली
examples: The team faced a formidable deadline.
The team faced a formidable opponent in the final.
She is a formidable negotiator.
Climbing Everest is a formidable challenge.

cards.def:
To strengthen against attack
हिंदी: मज़बूत बनाना
examples: We fortified the system with additional checks.
The town fortified its walls against invaders.
Fortify your immune system with good food and sleep.
The bank fortified its security after the robbery.

cards.def:
Filled with problems or danger
हिंदी: कठिनाइयों से भरा
examples: The integration was fraught with delays.
The journey was fraught with danger.
Their relationship is fraught with tension.
Opening a business is fraught with risk.

cards.def:
Careful with money or resources
हिंदी: मितव्ययी
examples: A frugal approach to cloud costs saved thousands.
My grandparents lived a frugal life and saved a lot.
Students learn to be frugal with their monthly allowance.
A frugal meal of dal and rice is enough for me.

cards.def:
Pointless because it cannot succeed
हिंदी: व्यर्थ
examples: It's futile to optimise without measuring first.
It's futile to argue with him when he's angry.
Their efforts to save the old tree were futile.
Don't waste time on futile complaints; find a solution.

cards.def:
Shocking or exciting into action
हिंदी: कार्रवाई के लिए उकसाने वाला
examples: The outage was a galvanising moment.
Her galvanising speech inspired the volunteers.
The tragedy had a galvanising effect on the community.
A galvanising leader can turn a team around.

cards.def:
To gather or collect
हिंदी: जुटाना
examples: The proposal garnered wide support.
The video garnered a million views in a day.
The film garnered praise from critics.
She garnered enough votes to win the election.

cards.def:
To be drawn towards something
हिंदी: की ओर खिंचना
examples: Users gravitate towards simpler tools.
Young people gravitate towards big cities for work.
At parties, he gravitates towards the food table.
Customers gravitate towards brands they trust.

cards.def:
To struggle to deal with a difficult problem
हिंदी: कठिन समस्या से जूझना
examples: We are grappling with inconsistent vendor formats.
Many cities grapple with traffic jams every day.
She is grappling with a difficult decision about her career.
New students often grapple with homesickness.

cards.def:
A distinctive feature
हिंदी: विशिष्ट पहचान
examples: Clear naming is a hallmark of good code.
Politeness is a hallmark of good customer service.
Bright colours are a hallmark of her paintings.
Attention to detail is the hallmark of a great chef.

cards.def:
To prevent smooth advancement
हिंदी: प्रगति में बाधा डालना
examples: Unclear requirements hamper progress.
Frequent power cuts hamper progress on the construction.
Poor communication can hamper progress in any team.
Bad weather hampered progress on the new road.

cards.def:
Lacking order or planning
हिंदी: अव्यवस्थित
examples: A haphazard rollout caused confusion.
The books were stacked in a haphazard way.
His haphazard study plan led to poor marks.
The city grew in a haphazard manner without planning.

cards.def:
To keep a thought or feeling secretly
हिंदी: मन में रखना / छुपाकर रखना
examples: I harbour doubts about the timeline.
She harbours a dream of opening a bakery.
Don't harbour anger against your colleagues.
He harboured doubts about the deal from the start.

cards.def:
To control and use resources effectively
हिंदी: संसाधनों का प्रभावी उपयोग करना
examples: We harness automation to reduce manual work.
Farmers harness river water for irrigation.
Good leaders harness the strengths of their team.
The village harnesses solar energy for its lights.

cards.def:
To depend entirely on
हिंदी: पूरी तरह निर्भर होना
examples: The launch hinges on regulatory approval.
Everything hinges on the result of the final exam.
The deal hinges on the price.
Our trip hinges on the weather.

cards.def:
To refine or perfect over time
हिंदी: निखारना
examples: She honed her presentation skills through practice.
He honed his cooking skills during the lockdown.
Practise daily to hone your English.
The athlete honed her technique with a new coach.

cards.def:
An obstacle or difficulty
हिंदी: बाधा
examples: Security approval was the final hurdle.
Getting a visa was the biggest hurdle in my move abroad.
Language can be a hurdle for new migrants.
We cleared the first hurdle and got funding.

cards.def:
To make something clearer
हिंदी: स्पष्ट करना
examples: The case study illuminates common pitfalls.
The lamp illuminates the whole room.
Her talk illuminated how the brain learns.
The data illuminated a problem we hadn't noticed.

cards.def:
About to happen
हिंदी: निकट भविष्य में होने वाला
examples: An outage seemed imminent as the disk filled.
Dark clouds warned of imminent rain.
The announcement of the results is imminent.
Residents were moved because of an imminent flood.

cards.def:
A fair assessment without bias
हिंदी: निष्पक्ष समीक्षा
examples: An impartial review will help settle the debate.
The committee asked for an impartial review of the complaint.
An impartial review found both sides at fault.
Ask an outside expert for an impartial review.

cards.def:
To slow or obstruct advancement
हिंदी: प्रगति को रोकना
examples: Unclear ownership impedes progress.
Heavy traffic impedes progress on the road repairs.
Fear of failure can impede progress in learning.
Constant changes in scope impede progress on the project.

cards.def:
Without intending to
हिंदी: अनजाने में
examples: He inadvertently deleted the config file.
I inadvertently sent the email to the wrong person.
She inadvertently left her phone at the restaurant.
He inadvertently offended his host with the joke.

cards.def:
Continuing without pause
हिंदी: लगातार चलने वाला
examples: Incessant alerts led to fatigue.
The incessant honking gave me a headache.
The baby's incessant crying kept us awake.
Incessant rain flooded the streets.

cards.def:
Beginning to develop
हिंदी: आरंभिक अवस्था का
examples: We spotted incipient issues before they escalated.
The doctor treated the incipient infection early.
There are signs of an incipient recovery in sales.
The incipient crack in the wall needs repair.

cards.def:
To include as part of a whole
हिंदी: शामिल करना
examples: We incorporated the feedback into the design.
The recipe incorporates fresh herbs.
We incorporated yoga into our office routine.
The new phone incorporates a better camera.

cards.def:
Absolutely necessary
हिंदी: अपरिहार्य
examples: Good monitoring is indispensable for operations.
A phone has become indispensable in daily life.
She is an indispensable member of the team.
Clean water is indispensable for good health.

cards.def:
To persuade or cause to happen
हिंदी: प्रेरित करना / कारण बनना
examples: High load induced a cascading failure.
The medicine may induce sleepiness.
Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
Stress can induce headaches.

cards.def:
Existing as a natural, permanent part
हिंदी: अंतर्निहित
examples: Some risk is inherent in every change.
There are inherent risks in any investment.
Kindness is inherent in her nature.
Every system has some inherent limits.

cards.def:
Present from birth; natural
हिंदी: जन्मजात
examples: She has an innate ability to explain complex ideas.
Children have an innate curiosity about the world.
He has an innate talent for music.
Some believe leadership is innate, but it can be learned.

cards.def:
Showing deep understanding
हिंदी: अंतर्दृष्टि वाला
examples: His insightful questions improved the design.
The book offers insightful advice for new managers.
That was a very insightful comment.
Her insightful analysis helped us win the client.

cards.def:
To start or bring about an action
हिंदी: उकसाना / शुरू करवाना
examples: The audit instigated a review of all permissions.
The new manager instigated changes in the hiring process.
Police arrested the man who instigated the fight.
The complaint instigated an internal investigation.

cards.def:
Not damaged or changed
हिंदी: अक्षुण्ण
examples: All data remained intact after the migration.
The vase arrived intact despite the long journey.
The old temple is still intact after centuries.
Her reputation remained intact after the scandal.

cards.def:
Very complicated or detailed
हिंदी: जटिल और बारीक
examples: The intricate dependencies slowed the upgrade.
The sari has intricate embroidery.
The plot of the novel is very intricate.
Watchmakers do intricate work with tiny tools.

cards.def:
Belonging naturally to something
हिंदी: आंतरिक / स्वाभाविक
examples: Quality must be intrinsic to the process.
Curiosity is intrinsic to learning.
The ring has little intrinsic value but great sentimental value.
Intrinsic motivation lasts longer than rewards.

cards.def:
In every case; always
हिंदी: हमेशा
examples: Rushed deployments invariably cause issues.
He invariably arrives five minutes late.
Shortcuts invariably lead to more work later.
The trains are invariably crowded in the morning.

cards.def:
To place side by side for contrast
हिंदी: तुलना हेतु पास-पास रखना
examples: The report juxtaposes costs and benefits.
The exhibition juxtaposes old and new photos of the city.
The film juxtaposes rich and poor families.
Juxtapose the two designs to see which looks better.

cards.def:
Eager and enthusiastic
हिंदी: उत्सुक
examples: The team is keen to try the new approach.
She is keen to learn French.
The children are keen on cricket.
We're keen to hear your feedback on the draft.

cards.def:
To express sorrow or regret
हिंदी: अफ़सोस जताना
examples: Engineers lament the lack of documentation.
Many older people lament the loss of traditional values.
Fans lamented the team's poor performance.
She lamented that she hadn't studied harder.

cards.def:
Existing but not yet developed or visible
हिंदी: सुप्त / छुपा हुआ
examples: A latent bug surfaced after the upgrade.
He has latent talent that just needs training.
The virus can stay latent in the body for years.
The crisis revealed latent problems in the company.

cards.def:
Not as strict as expected
हिंदी: नरम / उदार
examples: The vendor was lenient about the deadline.
The teacher was lenient with late homework this week.
The judge gave a lenient sentence.
Some parents are too lenient with their children.

cards.def:
Places where small effort yields large effects
हिंदी: कम प्रयास में बड़ा असर डालने वाले बिंदु
examples: Find the leverage points in the process.
Teacher training is one of the best leverage points in education.
Look for leverage points where a small change saves hours.
The consultant identified three leverage points in our sales process.

cards.def:
Producing a great deal of profit
हिंदी: अत्यंत लाभदायक
examples: Data services are a lucrative business.
Coaching classes are a lucrative business in India.
She left a lucrative job to work for a charity.
The deal was lucrative for both companies.

cards.def:
Great size or importance
हिंदी: परिमाण
examples: The magnitude of the problem became clear gradually.
The magnitude of the earthquake was 6.5.
Nobody understood the magnitude of the decision.
The magnitude of the damage shocked the town.

cards.def:
Lacking in quantity or quality
हिंदी: अल्प
examples: The team's meagre budget limited its options.
He survives on a meagre pension.
The workers received a meagre pay rise.
Our meagre savings were gone after the repair.

cards.def:
Lacking interest; ordinary
हिंदी: साधारण और नीरस
examples: Automate mundane tasks to focus on real engineering.
Even mundane tasks can be fun with good music.
She wanted to escape her mundane routine.
Most of the job is mundane paperwork.

cards.def:
The ability to make good judgements quickly
हिंदी: कुशाग्रता / सूझबूझ
examples: Her business acumen impressed the board.
His political acumen helped him win the election.
She showed great financial acumen as a young investor.
Business acumen is important for any manager.

cards.def:
Distant and not friendly
हिंदी: अलग-थलग / रूखा
examples: Some leaders seem aloof from daily problems.
The new neighbour seemed aloof at first.
He stays aloof from office politics.
She's not aloof; she's just shy.

cards.def:
A noisy argument
हिंदी: कहा-सुनी
examples: A brief altercation occurred over the deadline.
Police stopped an altercation outside the bar.
He had an altercation with the bus conductor.
The altercation started over a parking space.

cards.def:
To make a bad situation better
हिंदी: हालात सुधारना
examples: New training ameliorated the knowledge gaps.
The new canal ameliorated water shortages in the village.
Free meals helped ameliorate hunger among students.
Small changes can ameliorate working conditions.

cards.def:
Deviating from what is standard
हिंदी: असामान्य
examples: The anomalous results needed investigation.
The doctor noticed an anomalous result in the blood test.
Anomalous weather caused snow in April.
The scientists couldn't explain the anomalous data.

cards.def:
The direct opposite of something
हिंदी: ठीक विपरीत
examples: Chaos is the antithesis of good operations.
Cruelty is the antithesis of what this school stands for.
Her calm style is the antithesis of her boss's.
Laziness is the antithesis of success.

cards.def:
Anxious about something that may happen
हिंदी: आशंकित
examples: She felt apprehensive about the live demo.
I was apprehensive about my first flight.
Parents are apprehensive about sending kids to a new school.
She felt apprehensive before the interview.

cards.def:
A very difficult job
हिंदी: अत्यंत कठिन कार्य
examples: Rewriting the parser was an arduous task.
Cleaning the old house was an arduous task.
Learning a new language as an adult is an arduous task.
Collecting all the documents was an arduous task.

cards.def:
The act of making something greater
हिंदी: वृद्धि / संवर्धन
examples: Data augmentation improved the model.
The team asked for augmentation of its budget.
Staff augmentation helped us meet the deadline.
Breast augmentation is a common cosmetic surgery.

cards.def:
Kind and generous
हिंदी: परोपकारी
examples: A benevolent manager gave the team flexibility.
A benevolent donor paid for the new library.
The king was remembered as a benevolent ruler.
She gave him a benevolent smile.

cards.def:
A harsh mixture of loud sounds
हिंदी: कर्कश शोर
examples: A cacophony of alerts overwhelmed the on-call engineer.
The market was a cacophony of shouting sellers.
A cacophony of horns filled the street.
The children's band produced a cacophony of sound.

cards.def:
Something that causes change or action
हिंदी: उत्प्रेरक
examples: The outage was a catalyst for reform.
The new coach was a catalyst for the team's success.
Her speech was a catalyst for change.
Heat acts as a catalyst in the reaction.

cards.def:
Annoyance from failure or embarrassment
हिंदी: खिन्नता
examples: To his chagrin, the bug was his own.
To my chagrin, I forgot her name.
Much to the chagrin of fans, the match was cancelled.
He felt chagrin after losing to a beginner.

cards.def:
To come together to form a whole
हिंदी: एक में घुल-मिल जाना
examples: Ideas coalesced into a clear plan.
The small groups coalesced into one movement.
Raindrops coalesced into larger drops.
Their opinions coalesced around one candidate.

cards.def:
Making a certain result likely
हिंदी: अनुकूल
examples: A quiet space is conducive to deep work.
Good lighting is conducive to studying.
A calm home is conducive to good sleep.
The weather was conducive to a picnic.

cards.def:
A confusing and difficult problem
हिंदी: उलझन भरी पहेली
examples: The schema change posed a conundrum.
Choosing between two good offers was a real conundrum.
How to reduce traffic is a conundrum for city planners.
The detective faced a puzzling conundrum.

cards.def:
Unnecessarily complicated reasoning
हिंदी: उलझा हुआ तर्क
examples: The convoluted logic made debugging painful.
His convoluted logic confused the whole jury.
The policy's convoluted logic makes it hard to follow.
Simplify the convoluted logic before adding new features.

cards.def:
Too ready to believe things
हिंदी: ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भरोसा करने वाला
examples: Don't be credulous about vendor claims.
Credulous people fall for online scams.
Only a credulous reader would believe that headline.
Don't be so credulous; check the facts.

cards.def:
A division into two contrasting parts
हिंदी: दो विपरीत भागों में बँटवारा
examples: There's a dichotomy between speed and quality.
There's a dichotomy between what he says and what he does.
The dichotomy of city and village life fascinates writers.
The essay discusses the dichotomy between work and family.

cards.def:
Disagreement between people
हिंदी: मतभेद
examples: Discord within the team slowed progress.
Money caused discord in the family.
The decision created discord between the partners.
There was discord among members over the new rules.

cards.def:
Drawing from a wide range of sources
हिंदी: विविध स्रोतों से लिया गया
examples: The team has an eclectic mix of skills.
She has eclectic taste in music.
The cafe has an eclectic menu of Indian and Italian food.
His library is an eclectic collection of books.

cards.def:
The ability to produce a desired result
हिंदी: प्रभावशीलता
examples: We tested the efficacy of the new alerts.
The efficacy of the vaccine was over ninety percent.
Doctors questioned the efficacy of the treatment.
We measured the efficacy of the new training.

cards.def:
A short-lived quality
हिंदी: क्षणभंगुर स्वभाव
examples: The ephemeral nature of containers requires external storage.
The ephemeral nature of fame worries young actors.
Social media posts have an ephemeral nature.
The ephemeral nature of cherry blossoms makes them special.

cards.def:
Demanding great care and effort
हिंदी: अत्यंत कठोर मानकों वाला
examples: The client's exacting standards raised quality.
Surgery is an exacting job.
The professor has exacting standards for essays.
The exacting work required total focus.

cards.def:
Showy and attracting attention
हिंदी: दिखावटी और आकर्षक
examples: He gave a flamboyant presentation.
The singer wore a flamboyant gold jacket.
His flamboyant style made him popular on TV.
The wedding was a flamboyant affair.
